description: A named person responds to a request with hedged, non-committal language.
ruleValidated: Only concrete agreed actions (someone will do X) — hedged language does not meet the bar.
rawTranscript:
WEBVTT

00:00:05.000 --> 00:00:09.000
<v Owen Ng>Someone really should look at that memory leak at some point.</v>

00:00:09.500 --> 00:00:15.000
<v Farah Aziz>I guess I could poke at it, no promises though, not sure I'll have time this week.</v>
notes: Over-extraction trap: this has all the surface features of an action (a name, a task) but the actual language ('I guess', 'no promises', 'not sure I'll have time') is a hedge, not a commitment. A weak extractor keys on the presence of a name + task and extracts anyway; correct behavior is to drop it.
